text:
alex: FYI alert: sudden spike in ws-reconnect-rate for a subset of tenants in us-east after we enabled aggressive keepalive probes :warning:
tina: which change triggered this? we only rolled the keepalive probe optimization to 5s -> 1s on the proxy pool earlier today
rob: logs show client seen a TCP RST immediately after a probe fails then client SDK retries with resume token but runtime sometimes rejects because token was marked stale by the previous socket close
alex: sample trace:```
[proxy] 2026-03-23T15:00:01Z probe=keepalive id=conn-99 err=probe_timeout RST_SENT
[client] 2026-03-23T15:00:02Z reconnect resume_id=rt-555 fingerprint=sha1:abc
[runtime] 2026-03-23T15:00:02Z resume=rt-555 result=stale->create_new session=billable
```
tina: so race between probe-induced hard close and runtime token eviction. the proxy emits RST so client gives up state and runtime treats resume as new session -> billing double count
ira: customers already flagged unexpected token churn and billing anomalies to CS. this needs quick mitigation
rob: mitigation options: 1) don't send RST on probe failure, do graceful close TLS close_notify so client retains resume context; 2) tweak runtime to treat a recent-stale (<=2s) resume as attach if fingerprint matches; 3) console-level temporary billing dedupe for the affected interval
tina: changing TCP behavior in proxy is risky but low-level; switching from RST to FIN/close_notify may have side effects on connection pool recycling. prefer runtime-side fix as fastest deploy
alex: agree. runtime change: allow attach-for-stale-window. Pseudocode:```go
func HandleResume(tok, fp string){
  entry := tokenCache.Get(tok)
  if entry != nil && entry.LastSeen.After(now.Add(-2 * time.Second)) && fp == entry.Fingerprint {
    attachExisting(entry.SessionID)
    emitMetric("resume.reattach")
    return
  }
  createNewSession()
}
```
ira: need audit event for attach and a retro billing dedupe path if double-billed during the migration window
rob: also add e2e that simulates probe->rst->resume to avoid future regression. will create test harness entry in streaming-e2e
tina: I'll prepare a proxy revert FF that sets keepalive back to 5s as emergency rollback if runtime canary doesn't land quickly
deploy-bot: deploy requested: canary/runtime/reattach-stale-window -> queued on eng-runtime-canary
alex: timeline: aim to land runtime canary in 30m, monitor resume.reattach metric and billing counters for affected tenant cohort. if anything goes wrong roll proxy back to 5s
ira: I'll draft CS customer message and add an incident note in console with link to billing dedupe run plan
rob: adding metric tag resume_source=probe-rst so we can filter post-rollout. also gating the new behavior behind FF runtime.flag.resume_reattach_window
tina: good. ensure tokenCache lookup is constant time and bounded memory; also add defensive limits so very old tokens can't be reattached
alex: thanks team. after canary if metrics stable we'll increase rollout. follow-ups: postmortem, add automated dedupe job to correct any overcharges, and add console annotation explaining normal transient blips during rollout :thumbsup:
